name: Achilles Tendon Rupture
definition: Complete or partial rupture of the Achilles tendon, often occurring during sudden push-off, jumping or acceleration.

typical: Sudden snap or kick sensation in posterior ankle

investigations.MRI: Ultrasound/MRI helps when diagnosis is uncertain or for selected planning.
investigations.radiographs: Radiographs if associated fracture is suspected.

green: Early functional immobilization in plantar flexion
amber: Operative versus nonoperative treatment is individualized by age, activity, gap, comorbidity and local expertise.
red: Urgent red-flag features override routine conservative or Ayurvedic pathways.

ayurvedaFramework.text: Snayu/Kandara bhagna-like injury phenotype may be documented; modern rupture management remains primary.

patientEducation.summary: Complete or partial rupture of the Achilles tendon, often occurring during sudden push-off, jumping or acceleration.
patientEducation.urgent: Seek urgent assessment for acute/progressive neurological deficit, breathing/swallowing difficulty, sphincter change, severe infection/systemic illness, major trauma, vascular compromise or other listed red flags.
